text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident fired: Service=proxy-us-west | Trigger=5xx-rate > 2% | Incident=PD-INC-12345

maria: seeing duplicates — got alerts for us-west and eu-central at the same time, any idea why the metric doubled up?

alex: yep two PD incidents created ~30s apart, looks like our metrics exporter emitted duplicate series during a scrape window.

jeff: i'm oncall, acking both PD incidents now.

pd-bot: jeff acknowledged PD-INC-12345 (ack @ 7975312502)

jeff: quick check on dashboards — 5xx bump ~1.8% -> baseline 0.04%. traffic steady. might be noisy exporter, not user-facing errors yet.

tara: can we silence duplicates across regions for a short window? propose `silence:proxy-5xx-dup` for 10m. avoids cascading pages.

maria: doing silence ->```
# prometheus silence api
curl -XPOST "https://alertmgr.internal/api/v2/silences" -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"Proxy5xx"}],"startsAt":"now","endsAt":"+10m","comment":"temporary dedupe while we investigate"}'
```

oncall-runbook-bot: runbook 'pd-duplication' step 2 executed: silence created (`silence-id: s-78a9`) — notifying PD to hold escalations.

alex: logs: found `node-exporter-3` pod showing stuck metrics loop, repeated identical series for `proxy_up`. restarting that pod.

jeff: restart command run -> `kubectl rollout restart deployment/node-exporter -n infra-us-west`

maria: after restart, 5xx rate dropped back to baseline within ~90s. dashboards show normal.

pd-bot: PD incident PD-INC-12345 auto-resolved (no active alerts)

jeff: confirmed no customer-facing errors in last 10m. marking this as noise/flap.

tara: follow-up items: 1) increase PD dedupe window for cross-region identical alerts, 2) add exporter healthcheck and restart policy, 3) create alert to detect duplicate series from same scrape.

maria: created ticket ENGOPS-2350 for dedupe window + exporter healthcheck, assigned to platform.

alex: short-term tweak: add `alertmanager` filter: `group_by: [service, region, instance]` -> reduces cross-region duplication. will open PR.

jeff: leaving handoff notes in the incident timeline: no customer impact, root cause = flapping exporter emitting duplicate series.

maria: adding a brief note to runbook: https://internal.redwood.company/runbooks/pd-duplication (edit: added steps to silence and restart exporter)

alex: i'll ping infra/channel when PR is up. check again in 1h.

jeff: thanks all. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
